Name: Secacah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the wilderness of Judah
Description: Secacah was a town in Judah's wilderness allotment, named in the town list of Joshua 15. No further story is attached to it in Scripture, and its exact site is unidentified.
BiblicalSignificance: Its inclusion in the allotment list marks it as one of the towns assigned to Judah.
